label: H.R. 5100

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 5100 extends the authorization of the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, the Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program, and related pilot programs through fiscal year 2026.

affected_groups.effect: Can continue to receive competitive awards to conduct research and development projects with commercialization potential.
Can continue operating the research, technology transfer, and pilot programs through fiscal year 2026.
affected_groups.group: Federal agencies administering SBIR and STTR programs

key_provisions: Extends the SBIR program authority through September 30, 2026.
Extends the STTR program authority through fiscal year 2026.
Extends phase flexibility and accelerated awards programs through fiscal year 2026.

Extends multiple pilot programs, including the Commercialization Readiness Program for Civilian Agencies, Phase 0, Commercialization Assistance, Due Diligence, STTR Participation of Military Research and Educational Institutions, and Budget Calculation pilot programs through fiscal year 2026.
Extends provisions related to administrative assistance and increased minimum performance standards through September 30, 2026.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budget appropriations for the extended programs are not mentioned in the source.
Details on any new requirements or changes to how the programs operate besides extending their expiration dates are not provided.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 5100 extends the authorization of the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, the Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program, and related pilot programs through fiscal year 2026.
summary_detail.significance: The bill maintains current federal research and development funding programs for domestic small businesses by extending their expiration dates by one year to the end of fiscal year 2026.

title: To extend the SBIR and STTR programs, and for other purposes.
